\ednentry{
  id = {EDN-48},
  title = {The supported-make list is applied in the \texorpdfstring{\texttt{features}}{features} stage},
  note = {\textbf{Absorbs EDN-67} (2026-10-05): \texttt{features} became the one stage that applies the list.},
  date = {2026-09-30},
  milestone = {M2: Reproducibility},
  topic = {Evaluation Protocol, Data Preparation},
  participants = {@lukas2510},
  decision = {The \texttt{split} stage computes the supported-make list (EDN-05) and writes it as \texttt{data/\allowbreak{}processed/\allowbreak{}supported\_\allowbreak{}makes.\allowbreak{}json}, but removes no rows: every cleaned row lands in exactly one of its five artefacts.
The \texttt{features} stage restricts all five frames, the \texttt{ES} holdout included, to those makes before it builds any vocabulary.
\texttt{train} and \texttt{evaluate} check the property and fail when it does not hold.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item Filter in \texttt{split}: the split becomes lossy, and the threshold cannot be revisited without a new split.
\item Record the list and measure the metrics over every make: the gate would cover listings the API refuses with a 422.
\item Filter only the training rows: the holdout matrix would hold rows the model never receives.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} The reported population has to be the served population, and a vocabulary fitted on rows the API refuses would put unservable makes into the model's inputs.
Of the 6,079 holdout rows, 5,979 are a supported make.
One stage owns the rule, and its consumers check it.},
  ai = {Information seeking, Alternative generation, Alternative assessment, Recommendation, Solution generation},
  response = {Accepted},
  assessment = {AI found that the code comments and the two documents disagreed on where the filter belongs, and raised it as a decision instead of implementing one reading.
It corrected its own claim that out-of-scope rows would inflate the metrics.
An independent AI review later corrected the reasoning about the M6 replay, which reads the split frame and not a matrix.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code sessions of 2026-09-30 (issue \#35) and 2026-10-05 (issue \#63, review of PR \#71).},
  evidence = {``The supported makes'' in \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/docs/docs/pipeline.md}{the pipeline docs}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/reports/analysis/served_vocabulary_results.txt}{\texttt{served\_\allowbreak{}vocabulary\_\allowbreak{}results.\allowbreak{}txt}}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/pull/71}{PR \#71}.},
